newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ultronics says in stake sale, merger talk.
newsitem.headline: Ultronics says in stake sale, merger talk.

text.p: Medical and scientific equipment distributor Ultronics International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its controlling shareholders were in talks with an independent third party on a merger or stake sale.

"Preliminary discussions have taken place regarding a possible merger of the company with the independent third party or the acquisition by the independent third party of substantial interest in the company," Ultronics said in a statement.
Ultronics said the possible deal might give rise to an obligation for the third party to make a general offer for the company's shares.
"No plans of asset injection into the company by the independent third party were discussed during such discussion," it said, adding there had been no binding agreement.
The company's controlling shareholders include Lee Man Kin, Tse Kam Pang and Edwin Wong. Lee owns 28.29 percent of the company, Tse holds 8.78 percent and Wong has 10.01 percent.
Trading in Ultronics shares resumed on Thursday after a two-day suspension. The shares were HK$0.105 higher at HK$0.56 just before the midday break.
